sections.heading: MINOR IN ETHICS
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - Philosophy

2.5 courses in Philosophy at the 2000 level or above in areas of Ethics, Applied Ethics, Political Philosophy or Philosophy of Law. Eligible courses include: Philosophy 2062F/G, Philosophy 2074F/G, Philosophy 2077F/G, Philosophy 2710F/G, Philosophy 2715F/G, Philosophy 2720F/G, Philosophy 2750F/G, Philosophy 2800F/G, Philosophy 2801F/G, Philosophy 2810F/G, Philosophy 2821F/G, Philosophy 2822F/G, Philosophy 3170F/G, Philosophy 3180F/G, Philosophy 3710F/G, Philosophy 3720F/G.
1.0 additional course in Philosophy at the 2000 level or above.
Note: The Minor in Ethics may not be combined with the Certificate in Ethics.
